in_marathi.name: Anjay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anjay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anjay is a Sanskrit name, derived from the term 'Anj' which means 'An' (without) and 'Jay' (victory). This name signifies the one who attains victory without any effort, through God's grace.
